sections.notes: Reviewed current OSM way 24008477 version 28: highway=residential, embedded_rails=tram, surface=asphalt. GTFS follows the mapped general-traffic carriageway. Bounds are endpoint projections inset 10m to avoid transitions. Map-derived classification; no legal exclusivity claim or retrospective August validity.

Bounded 200m median-track section containing the Jackson imagery anchor. Images captured 2016-02-27 show tracks on a separate median beside general traffic; current OSM railway geometry corroborates alignment. Reserved means separated from routine longitudinal road traffic, with at-grade crossing conflicts retained. Applied prospectively from review; older images do not establish uninterrupted historical/current operation. This is a map/imagery inference, not a field survey.
